inputs.text: The IOC is right to put fairness and safety before activist demands. Women’s sport only means something if it protects a genuinely fair category for women; ignoring biological differences would sacrifice their opportunities to political fashion. Kirsty Coventry said it plainly: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Excluding transgender women and DSD athletes from that category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games is a necessary, common-sense defense of women’s sport. Clear rules protect trust; institutions should enforce them rather than yield to pressure.
